title: PBA: Ricci Rivero leads Phoenix comeback win over Meralco

blocks.text: Phoenix, with Ricci Rivero playing the lead role, assured itself a spot in the quarterfinals of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup after coming back to defeat Meralco, 105-101, on Friday at Ynares Center in Antipolo. Rivero had 26 points, nine rebounds, seven assists, three steals and two blocks, new import Marcellus Earlington picked it up in the fourth while Kai Ballungay, Kenneth Tuffin and Gian Mamuyac were also key in Phoenix securing a virtual seat into the quarters. The Fuel Masters improved to 5-3 for second in Group B after snapping a two-game skid, and will officially clinch the quarters if […]...
